annotations.title: Size a HUD 232 nursing home refinance (223(f) or 223(a)(7))

description: Runs the SNF Register sizer: HUD Section 232 loan tests (debt service at 1.45x or 1.11x with MIP, 80%/85% loan to value, cost to refinance, original principal for 223(a)(7)) on your NOI, value, rate and payoff; returns the maximum insurable loan, the binding test, payment, MIP, DSCR and cash to close. Pass a CCN to fill in its active FHA loan.

beds.description: Beds (sets the 223f inspection fee). Default the CCN's certified beds, else 120.

borrower.description: Nonprofit with an operating track record gets 85% LTV instead of 80%.

ccn.description: Six-character CMS certification number (CCN), e.g. "015109". search_nursing_homes returns it.

current_monthly_pi.description: 223a7 only: current monthly principal and interest, to show the payment change. Defaults from ccn.

financing_fee_pct.description: Lender financing fee, % of loan (capped at 3.5% for 223f, 2% for 223a7). Default 2.

noi.description: Underwritten net operating income, $ a year.

original_principal.description: 223a7 only: original principal of the FHA loan (caps the new loan). Defaults from ccn.

other_costs.description: Other closing costs, $ (third-party reports, legal, title, prepayment premium).

payoff.description: Existing debt to pay off, $. Defaults to the active FHA balance when ccn is given.

program.description: 223f = 232/223(f) refinance of non-HUD debt; 223a7 = streamlined refinance of an existing FHA loan. Default 223a7 when ccn has an active FHA loan, else 223f.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate, percent (your quote or assumption; HUD does not set it).

term_years.description: Term in years. Default 35, or the active loan's remaining term for 223a7 with ccn.
